name: rubrist
description: Set up and use a Rubrist evaluator project from a coding agent. The rubrist-setup skill inspects safe project text, asks one short decision-changing question, proposes one plain-language Check, and connects it as Starter · unvalidated only after you choose Finish setup. The rubrist-audit skill captures real input/output examples, submits them for judging through a bundled zero-dependency script, and reports Results as counts, never claiming an unlabeled run was verified. Both skills need a running Rubrist instance and keep pairing tokens and keys out of chat and Git.
